title: G-code Programmer
description:
We are seeking a skilled G-code Programmer to join our team in Haryana. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of G-code programming and its applications in CNC machining. This role is crucial for ensuring precision and efficiency in our manufacturing processes. Key Responsibilities: - Develop and optimize G-code programs for CNC machines to ensure high-quality production. - Collaborate with engineers and machinists to understand project requirements and specifications. - Troubleshoot and resolve programming issues to minimize downtime and enhance productivity. - Conduct regular maintenance and updates to existing G-code programs to improve performance. - Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards in all programming tasks. Required Skills: - Proficiency in G-code programming and CNC machine operation. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications. - Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality. - Strong communication skills to work effectively in a team environment. If you are passionate about programming and have the required skills, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to contribute to our innovative manufacturing processes.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: MES Automation
description:
**Job Title** 
 :MES Automation
 



**Experience:** 
 8 to 15 Years
 



**Industry:** 
 Automobile
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Lead end\-to\-end MES implementation, integration and rollout across manufacturing plants.
* Drive shop\-floor automation, Industry 4\.0 and Smart Manufacturing initiatives.
* Integrate MES with ERP, SCADA, PLC, IoT and machine systems.
* Digitalise manual manufacturing processes and improve real\-time production visibility.
* Lead IT\-OT integration, technology selection, vendors and implementation partners.
* Drive initiatives around OEE, traceability, quality, production monitoring and analytics.
* Manage and lead Manufacturing IT / MES / Digital Transformation teams.
* Work closely with Production, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain and Business leadership.



  





**Must Have:** 




  




* 10\+ years in Manufacturing IT / MES / Digital Transformation / Automation.
* Strong experience in Automobile / Auto Components manufacturing.
* Proven experience in MES implementation and digitalisation.
* Good understanding of MES/MOM, ERP, SCADA, PLC, IoT and Industry 4\.0\.
* Experience managing large\-scale implementation projects and vendors.
* Strong IT\-OT integration and stakeholder management experience.
